subject: QBR alignment: OKR gap-bridging and pricing guardrails
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@acme.com>, acme-ops@acme.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: QBR alignment: OKR gap-bridging and pricing guardrails

Team —

Attached is a working draft of the QBR playbook (qbr_playbook_v0.9.pdf) and the pricing guardrails workbook (pricing-guardrails.xlsx). High-level ask: before our QBR dry-run (scheduled below), I need a short status check on GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support readiness.

Current OKR snapshot (high-level):
- OKR 1 (Activation): 60% — owner: Karthik
- OKR 2 (Enablement): 45% — owner: Marissa
- OKR 3 (Pricing/Revenue): 70% — owner: Laura
- OKR 4 (Support SLOs): 80% — owner: Kimberly

Please reply with (a) two-line readiness summary, (b) top 1 blocker, and (c) owner-confirmed mitigation by EOD Apr 12 PT. If there are items you want pulled into the playbook, add them to the Drive link and flag below.

Proposed dry-run: Apr 14, 09:00 PT, 30min. Agenda: 1) One-slide per function (2 mins) 2) Risk heatmap & decision thresholds (10 mins) 3) Q&A & escalation path (10 mins) 4) Final ask list (8 mins)

Key notes from my side:
- Pricing guardrails: Please review the \"hard\" vs \"soft\" constraints in the second tab — we need final sign-off from Finance by Apr 13.
- Docs: we have two customer-facing guides still in draft (see section 3.2 in playbook).
- Support runbook: Kimberly, can you confirm the CS escalation owner for P0s across regions?

Thanks — short replies appreciated.

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Head, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR alignment: OKR gap-bridging and pricing guardrails

Thanks, Olga — quick update from infra & GTM.

Readiness: GTM tooling and rollout plan are 75% complete. Canary infra is still pending a config update that blocks sustained 24h load testing.
Top blocker: Canary infra config (deployment tokens + autoscaler tuning).
Mitigation: Eng infra will push a hotfix tomorrow (Apr 12) AM; Karthik to own verification and confirm by EOD Apr 12.

Regarding pricing guardrails — noted. I'll sync with Finance and tag Laura for final sign-off; if Finance needs more time we'll use the conservative "soft" pricing band for initial rollouts.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Serving Orchestration
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR alignment: OKR gap-bridging and pricing guardrails

Thanks for the draft, Olga.

Enablement readiness: 50% (owner: Marissa). Top blocker: Docs backlog + translations (ES/DE) that support field enablement playbooks.

Details:
- Two customer-facing quickstarts (Integrations + Admin Setup) are only at first draft; we need an additional technical writer to finish translations. ETA without extra headcount: Apr 20.
- Suggested mitigation: Push the enablement release to Apr 16 with a "quickstart-first" strategy (ship two quickstarts now, follow with expanded guides); or we can keep Apr 14 if GTM accepts a limited enablement bundle (risk: field readiness reduced).

I'll upload the enablement checklist and gap matrix to the Drive link.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Manager, Enablement

Subject: Re: QBR alignment: OKR gap-bridging and pricing guardrails — Decisions & Runbook

All —

Thanks for the quick updates. Summary & decisions:
- Karthik to own Canary infra verification; target: deployment verification complete by EOD Apr 12 (confirmed: infra pushed fix at 10:30 Apr 12).
- Marissa: we'll adopt the \"quickstart-first\" plan — enablement release window moved to Apr 16; Marissa to prioritize Integrations + Admin Setup quickstarts and mark translations as tier-2.
- Laura & Finance: please confirm final pricing sign-off by Apr 13 12:00 PT. If not confirmed, GTM will ship under the \"soft\" band and Finance will finalize post-rollout.
- Kimberly: CS escalation owner for P0s is set to Leah Mendoza (cc'd on the support runbook in Drive). Kimberly to validate SLO offsets by Apr 14.

Dry-run reminder: Apr 14, 09:00 PT. Please come prepared with one slide per function and the top 3 mitigations.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik — Canary verify + traffic test logs (artifact link in Drive)
- Marissa — Enablement quickstarts + checklist (upload by Apr 15)
- Laura — Final pricing sign-off or documented fallback (by Apr 13 noon)
- Kimberly — Validate P0 owner & SLO offsets (by Apr 14)

If anyone objects to the timeline changes, call it out now. Otherwise I'll treat this as the final pre-QBR plan.

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Head, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
